Agent 03/35 — binary steering slew/tap response. Audit normal wind-on, recenter and reversal rates of the new digital controller at 20/40/70/100/140 km/h. Measure 50/100/150/250 ms taps, sustained holds and chicane direction changes. Goal: fast enough to place the car precisely, never a delayed mushy response, while avoiding high-speed step input saturation. Do not change tire grip or physical rack. Any patch must be minimal, speed-continuous, symmetric and have deterministic timing tests plus full M5 validation.
